translations.web: When he had spoken these words to me, I set my face toward the ground, and was mute.
translations.bsb: While he was speaking these words to me, I set my face toward the ground and became speechless.
translations.kjv: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.
translations.asv: and when he had spoken unto me according to these words, I set my face toward the ground, and was dumb.
